header.name: FallingTree RP [WIDEGRID $debugger$ v2.8.1]
header.description: v2.8.0 WIDEGRID — unified 7×7 entity envelope with per-species geometries and dimensions. 10 species each have their own canopy cube layout within a shared 7×7 grid; each uses only the cells it needs. Acacia now has angled branch_l/branch_r shoulder stubs (rotated ±30°) under a flat umbrella canopy. Texture atlas upgraded 128×128 → 256×256 with Patrix HD leaves tiled 2×2 per species. Per-species visible_bounds: oak/birch 6w22h, spruce 4w26h, jungle 8w22h, acacia 8w24h, dark_oak 8w21h, mangrove 6w21h, cherry 7w23h, crimson/warped 4w24h. These drive fall animation curve, impact timing, collision corridor, and future per-species physics. DAMAGE fix: EntityDamageCause.entityAttack enum imported and used (prior builds passed raw string which engine rejected silently); camerashake intensified 1.2/0.6, knockback strength 2.2 / vertical 0.6; all 3 effects now fire independently so a single failure doesn't cascade. ft:canopy_size property removed (ft:wood_type drives geometry directly). DEBUG=true. v2.8.1: added "capabilities":["pbr"] to RP manifest so Vibrant Visuals toggle is no longer greyed out.
